item.title: Affidavits: Argument at bar leads to fatal parking lot stabbing in downtown San Angelo
item.description: What started as an altercation at a pub in San Angelo escalated into a fatal stabbing in the parking lot of a different bar in the downtown area on the morning of March 21, court records indicate.

item.title: 87-year-old Coleman man killed in early morning car accident
item.description: Bobby Eugene Dickinson, 87, of Coleman, Texas, died in a single-vehicle crash on County Road 402 after failing to negotiate a curve, causing the vehicle to roll over and catch fire.

item.title: Tom Green County jail logs: March 24, 2026
item.description: From 7 a.m. on Monday, March 23, to 7 a.m. Tuesday, March 24, 2026, 16 people were booked into the Tom Green County Detention Center.

item.title: Shannon Medical Center offers comprehensive home care services
item.description: Shannon Medical Center offers a range of at home care services, including help with walking, bathing, grooming, hygiene, meal preparation, transportation, medication reminders, and more, with caregivers available 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays and weekends.

item.title: San Angelo Planning Commission tables data center regulations
item.description: The City of San Angelo's Planning Commission passed a motion to table an amendment that would adopt land use regulations for data centers, during its Monday meeting.
